_readme: Runs of the current trainer (views/index.pug and client/game.ts), recorded in Chrome on 2026-10-23 for the engine's parity test (run.test.ts). Each run sets the settings in localStorage, then fires a scripted spray under Playwright's fake clock, paused so that time only moves when the script advances it, while an init script logs, in order, every mouse event (in stage coordinates) and every animation frame the old code saw; times are in ms after the first press. result is what the old code computed (its window.__spraydownLastRun hook); stored is the score it put in the history (game::stats), or null when the run did not count. The engine must reproduce every shot's time and score exactly.
